provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: All retention times come from one isothermal run. Adjusted retention t_prime=t_retention-t_hold_up>0. Define Kovats I=100*[n+(ln(t_prime_analyte)-ln(t_prime_n))/(ln(t_prime_(n+1))-ln(t_prime_n))]. The analyte lies between the adjacent n-alkanes.
comparison: The wrong comparison requested is linear interpolation of the ORIGINAL unadjusted times between those same anchors, with indices800and900. It is a different numerical descriptor, not the isothermal index. No temperature-programmed method, co-injection or structural spectrum is provided.
scope: A reproducible chromatographic descriptor can be identified without uniquely identifying a molecule. No unprovided candidate registry lookup should be substituted.
